title: I'm making a tactical RTT where houses fall apart, wounds depend on where you get hit, and armor burns
author: Ok_Meat9456
selftext:
Hey everyone! I've been working solo on Battle Ghosts, a real-time tactical military RTS focused on close-quarters urban combat. Here's about 3 minutes of raw gameplay from the current build.

What you're seeing:

\- Squad command: you lead squads (Alfa, Bravo, Charlie) and give orders in real time: move, attack, suppress, crouch, prone, regroup.

\- Soldiers that react on their own: under fire they seek cover, peek corners, reload and return fire. A squad under heavy suppression gets PINNED and can't advance.

\- Wounds by body region: a soldier can go DOWN (wounded) or KIA depending on where he gets hit. Blood and ragdolls come straight from the hit.

\- Destructible buildings – houses are built from blocks and break apart piece by piece. A cutaway view lets you see who's inside.

\- Grenades and smoke: real throw arcs, and smoke to cross a street without being seen.

\- Armor: the Urutu, a Brazilian APC you can drive and load with troops. It can be destroyed too: one good hit and it becomes a burning wreck.

comments.author: Xinnobun
comments.body: Good work so far. They really need to upgrade their weapons though, BB guns in warfare is a little odd
